description: This Java class defines a PaymentMethod data model used in a sales or e-commerce context. It encapsulates properties such as payment method code, payment type, default selection status, and associated integration modules and configurations.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A serializable model class representing a payment method with associated metadata and configuration information for display and processing in a storefront environment.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the type of payment associated with this payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for this payment method.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifying this payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this payment method.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Indicates if this payment method is the default selection.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether this payment method is the default selected.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the integration module associated with this payment method.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the integration module for this payment method.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Returns the integration configuration for this payment method.

methods.name: setInformations
methods.description: Sets the integration configuration for this payment method.
